close_reason: Fixed alongside two sibling idiom beads in commit 3cc7eab (.59, .62, .60 batched into one commit because each is 1-3 lines and each is in a file already touched in this review pass). cargo test, clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings, rustdoc all green.
description: utils.rs:72 has '_ => "Dec"' as the catch-all arm of a match on chrono parsed.month() (u32). chrono::Datelike::month() returns values in 1..=12 by API contract — the catch-all is unreachable. The current form silently returns 'Dec' (December) for any unexpected input, which is wrong on its face: 'if we don't know the month, claim it's December' is misleading rather than safe. Idiomatic fixes (any of): (a) use 'unreachable!("chrono::Datelike::month() returns 1..=12")' — flags refactor regressions explicitly; (b) restructure to use 'chrono::Month::try_from(parsed.month() as u8).ok().map(|m| m.name()).unwrap_or("")' — handles the impossible case explicitly; (c) eliminate the match entirely via parsed.format("%b") (see sibling finding). Engineering basis: future refactor that swaps chrono for another date lib could silently produce wrong output (everything becomes December) instead of a panic or compile error.
title: utils.rs month match uses '_ => "Dec"' catch-all that is misleading dead code
